changes: First library release for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74, on core-ar2 0.7, approved by the owner on 2 November 2026. Three SEQUENCER CONFIG checkboxes: pads and TRIG keys select silently, pads stay silent in LIVE RECORDING, and MUTE ALL SOUND keeps a muted track silent.
stockPolicy: No firmware or stock-derived code/tables are present. Addresses, lengths and SHA-256 guards are metadata; exported instructions and sections are authored module code. Local materialized recipes and firmware are never committed.
